bullets.text: Five European Union countries, including Germany and Denmark, have announced plans to establish a "return hub" in Rwanda for failed asylum seekers, a policy that has faced criticism as a grave moral failing.
Russia reported the largest Ukrainian drone attack of the war, with over 2,000 drones launched in a single day, while Kyiv experienced a record 17 air raid alerts.
Two mass shootings in South Africa, one in KwaZulu-Natal and another in Gauteng, have resulted in 17 fatalities, highlighting the nation's ongoing struggle with violent crime.
The Medical Board of Australia has imposed conditions on surgeon Stefaan De Clercq following the death of his patient, Joanne Downie, at Bundaberg Hospital in October 2023.
A man has been arrested in connection with the theft of three Melbourne Cup trophies won by Makybe Diva from Flemington, though the trophies remain missing.
A new poll indicates that the Coalition has moved ahead of Labor in two-party preferred polling for the first time since the federal election.
US tech stocks, including the Nasdaq 100, experienced a significant slide, with investors remaining cautious about the AI trade ahead of Nvidia's earnings and Anthropic's expected IPO.
Brazilian financial markets, including the real and corporate bonds, slumped due to increasing concerns over the government's fiscal plans, leading to expectations of sustained high interest rates.
A group of banks led by Citigroup Inc. withdrew a debt deal for IT provider UST Global Inc. from the syndicated loan market after failing to attract sufficient investor demand.
